evidence_dispersion.rationale: The target editor, adjacent audit policy, and readiness interface span three files connected by one conceptual dependency boundary.

contract_opacity.rationale: AuditEditor names an explicit ready boundary, but the maintenance prompt does not state whether RecordEditor should wait or retain declarative ownership.

temporal_composition.rationale: The rubric separates target form readiness from preservation of the adjacent remote-owned editor.

schedule_complexity.rationale: Two schedules distinguish a fresh form registration from an already-ready retained form.

consumer_heterogeneity.rationale: RecordEditor migrates to local configuration while AuditEditor must retain remote configuration ownership.

repair_locus_ambiguity.rationale: Plausible repairs can retain declarative values, await readiness in RecordEditor, or change the shared form port; an unrelated event-loop yield is a further partial repair.

framework_execution_complexity.rationale: One asynchronous registration boundary determines whether imperative writes are accepted.

structured_judgment.rationale: The target and adjacent editor intentionally have different configuration ownership.

contract_recovery.rationale: Recovery requires comparing the two editors with the readiness interface.

maintenance.rationale: The repair must migrate only RecordEditor and use actual readiness rather than incidental scheduling.
